claims.quote: This unique dwarf barb (max. 4 cm total length) from Burma has a red “moustache”.

To date known only from the upper Ayeyarwady River basin in northern Myanmar with type locality 'Hap Lap Chaung just south of Yuzana Myaing village, 8 kilometers left from Myitkyina-Myitzon road kilometer 11, Ayeyarwaddy River drainage, Kachin State, Myanmar'.

regions.name: Lake Indawgyi
regions.quote: It's been collected from small streams and tributaries close to the city of Myitkyina in Kachin State as well as in nearby Lake Indawgyi, the largest inland lake in Southeast Asia.
